question: Three couples are sitting at a round table facing the center. No more than two men (or two women) are sitting next to each other. No man is sitting next to his wife. B is sitting to the immediate left of C whose wife is sitting exactly opposite the letter. A and his wife are sitting on either side of the wife of C. who are sitting to the immediate left and the immediate right of A?

options.text: The wives of B and C
The wives of C and B
C and the wife of B
B and the wife of C

solution:
**Given : **

 
• Three couples are sitting at a round table facing the center.
 
• No more than two men (or two women) are sitting next to each other.
 
• No man is sitting next to his wife.

**Explanation : **

1) B is sitting to the immediate left of C whose wife is sitting exactly opposite the letter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d4c2236f5870bcefbedce9d111a09a67aa580ec2018b64c7853260a3a964de2.png] 

2) A and his wife are sitting on either side of the wife of C.

As no more than two men (or two women) are sitting next to each other, therefore A's wife is seated to the immediate right of C's wife.

After positioning A and A's wife only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e B's wife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2e1b307d10b00382eb290c43b705365a783ff468b43242b779fb6f796536685.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement B's wife and C's wife are sitting to the immediate left and the immediate right of A respectively.

Hence, **"Option - (1)"** is the correct answer.
